axes.name: high_byte_expression_and_lifetime
axes.rationale: Unsigned 16-bit high-byte mask; all expressions identical for every input, temporary lifetime affects scheduling
values: WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context & 0xff00);

context = context & 0xff00;
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context);
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, (context >> 8) << 8);

context = (context >> 8) << 8;
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context);
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, (context / 256) * 256);

context = (context / 256) * 256;
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context);
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context - (unsigned char)context);

context = context - (unsigned char)context;
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context);
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, (unsigned int)((unsigned char *)&context)[1] << 8);

context = (unsigned int)((unsigned char *)&context)[1] << 8;
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context);
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, ((unsigned char *)&context)[1] * 256U);

context = ((unsigned char *)&context)[1] * 256U;
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context);
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context & ~255U);

context = context & ~255U;
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context);
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, (context | 255U) ^ 255U);

context = (context | 255U) ^ 255U;
WinHelp(rootWnd, 0x58a1, 0x76ac, 1, 0, context);
